main_body: straw mattress bed with a pillow on top and a wooden footboard/legs at the south end
top_band: yellow-tan straw mattress top surface with a pale pillow from row 5 to row 22 (framed by brown rails at rows 4 and 23)
evidence: As a low horizontal bed oriented north-south, the top surface of the straw mattress (rows 5-22, with a lighter front edge at row 20 and fringe at rows 21-22) and the vertical south footboard and legs below the frame rail (rows 24-29) are both clearly shown.

style.evidence: Compared to the Beodeul references, the bed has very shallow ramps: only 3 tones on the straw (with the dark speckle reusing the exact flat frame colour), 2 tones on the pillow with no cast shadow, and a completely unshaded 1-colour border along all 26 rows of the left/right frame rails.
